#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02111">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2111 FPC - History duration is less than</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02111">

The exception applies to both gas and liquid periodic data where the meter is configured with a record resolution of hourly in meter characteristics and the Run on Imports and Edits option is set to "Yes" in the Meter Editor. If a periodic record has a duration less than zero, then this exception will be generated.

If the flow data provided is in a no flow state, then this exception will not be generated.

A record is considered to be in a no flow state when:

<table class="FcTable" style="margin-left: 0;margin-right: auto;width: 510px;">
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center; background-color: #696969; color: #ffffff; border-left-style: solid; border-left-width: 0px; border-left-color: #c0c0c0; border-right-style: solid; border-right-width: 0px; border-right-color: #c0c0c0; border-top-style: solid; border-top-width: 0px; border-top-color: #c0c0c0; border-bottom-style: solid; border-bottom-width: 0px; border-bottom-color: #c0c0c0; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px; padding-top: 5px; padding-bottom: 5px;">Record Type</th>
<th style="text-align: center; background-color: #696969; color: #ffffff; border-left-style: solid; border-left-width: 1px; border-left-color: #c0c0c0; border-right-style: solid; border-right-width: 0px; border-right-color: #c0c0c0; border-top-style: solid; border-top-width: 0px; border-top-color: #c0c0c0; border-bottom-style: solid; border-bottom-width: 0px; border-bottom-color: #c0c0c0; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px; padding-top: 5px; padding-bottom: 5px;">Conditions</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="background-color: #ffffff">Gas</td>
<td style="text-align: left; border-left-style: solid; border-left-width: 1px; border-left-color: #c0c0c0; border-right-style: solid; border-right-width: 0px; border-right-color: #c0c0c0; border-top-style: solid; border-top-width: 0px; border-top-color: #c0c0c0; border-bottom-style: solid; border-bottom-width: 0px; border-bottom-color: #c0c0c0; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px; padding-top: 5px; padding-bottom: 5px; background-color: #ffffff;"><ul>
<li>Orifice/V-Cone
<ul>
<li>DP is undefined; and
<ul>
<li>Flow Time is undefined or 0; and</li>
</ul></li>
<li>Cut off Alarm is defined and not 0; and
<ul>
<li>Volume is 0; and</li>
<li>DP is less than the cut off alarm</li>
</ul></li>
</ul></li>
<li>Turbine
<ul>
<li>Volume is 0; and</li>
<li>Flow Time is 0 or Frequency is 0</li>
</ul></li>
<li>All other meter types
<ul>
<li> Volume is 0; and</li>
<li>Flow Time is 0 or Pulses is 0</li>
</ul></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="background-color: #f5f5f5">Liquids</td>
<td style="text-align: left; border-left-style: solid; border-left-width: 1px; border-left-color: #c0c0c0; border-right-style: solid; border-right-width: 0px; border-right-color: #c0c0c0; border-top-style: solid; border-top-width: 0px; border-top-color: #c0c0c0; border-bottom-style: solid; border-bottom-width: 0px; border-bottom-color: #c0c0c0; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px; padding-top: 5px; padding-bottom: 5px; background-color: #f5f5f5;"><ul>
<li>Orifice
<ul>
<li>DP is undefined; and
<ul>
<li>Flow Time is undefined or 0; and</li>
</ul></li>
<li>Cut off Alarm is defined and not 0; and
<ul>
<li>Volume is 0; and</li>
<li>DP is less than the cut off alarm</li>
</ul></li>
<li>Volume is 0; and</li>
<li>DP is 0</li>
</ul></li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li>API Volumetric/API Inferred Volume/Orifice Data Only/API Orifice Volumetric
<ul>
<li>NSV is 0</li>
</ul></li>
<li>All other calculation methods
<ul>
<li>Mass is 0</li>
</ul></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02112">

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02113">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2113 FPC - Flow time is less than zero</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02113">

This exception is generated when the Flow time on an imported CFX or text file is \< 0 seconds. For Example, a CFX file with bad data at 09/07/2016 12:00:00 is imported into FLOWCAL. The Flow time for that record is “-1” which is not a logical quantity. FLOWCAL will not display that quantity in the Volume Editor, leaving “Flow Time” blank and highlighted while throwing exception 2113:



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 615;height: 212;" />



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 614;height: 137;" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02114">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2114 FPC - Flow time is more than 1 hour</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02114">

This exception is generated when the Flow time on an imported CFX or text file is \> 3600 seconds. For Example, a CFX file with bad data at 09/07/2016 09:00:00 is imported into FLOWCAL. The Flow time for that record is “3601” which is not a logical quantity. FLOWCAL will display the additional second in the Volume Editor but will highlight the offending record’s Flow Time while throwing exception 2114:



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 616;height: 199;" />



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 617;height: 133;" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02115">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2115 FPC - Low volume</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02115">

This exception is generated when a record’s Volume exceeds the user defined limit for minimum volume. For example, the minimum volume is set to 200.0000, but the meter’s volume is imported at 180.0000.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02116">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02116">

This exception is generated when a record’s Volume exceeds the user defined limit for maximum volume. For example, the maximum volume is set to 950.0000, but the meter’s volume is imported at 965.0000

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02118">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02137">

To resolve this exception, check that all required fields are properly filled in and recalculate CF. To recalculate CF, go to the Volume Editor and select a periodic record under Flow Data \> Periodic tab. On the Flow Data Details editor, change the Recalc drop-down to “Correlation Factor”, select an edit reason and click Apply.

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02138">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2138 FPC - Low speed of sound</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02138">

This exception is generated when the Speed of Sound value falls below the minimum limit set in the Meter Editor for an ultrasonic meter. For example the minimum Speed of Sound is set to 401, but the Speed of Sound on a meter is imported at 400.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02139">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2139 FPC - High speed of sound</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02139">

This exception is generated when the Speed of Sound value falls beyond the maximum limit set up in the Meter Editor for an ultrasonic meter. For example the maximum Speed of Sound is set to 407, but the Speed of Sound on a meter is imported at 408.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02140">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2140 FPC - No flow</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02140">

This exception is generated when the Skip No Flow Exceptions option is set to "No" in the Meter Editor. For example, if there is a break in the data for the month of August that has zero flow and the Skip No Flow Exceptions option is set to "No", this exception will be generated:



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 616;height: 371;" />



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 615;height: 367;" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02141">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2141 FPC - Low flow time</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02141">

This exception is generated when the Flow Time quantity falls below the minimum limit set up in the Meter Editor. For example, the minimum flow time is set to 000:05:00, but the meter record’s flow time is 000:03:00.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02142">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2142 FPC - High flow time</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02142">

This exception is generated when the Flow Time quantity falls beyond the maximum limit set up in the Meter Editor. For example, the maximum flow time is set to 000:55:00, but the meter record’s flow time is 001:00:00.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02143">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2143 FPC - Low mass</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02143">

This exception is generated when the Mass quantity falls below the minimum limit set up in the Meter Editor for a gas meter or a liquid meter with the Direct Mass or Inferred Mass calc method. For example, the minimum Mass is set to 950, but the Mass on the meter is imported at 925.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02144">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2144 FPC - High mass</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02144">

This exception is generated when the Mass quantity falls beyond the maximum limit set up in the Meter Editor for a gas meter or a liquid meter with the Direct Mass or Inferred Mass calc method.. For example, the maximum Mass is set to 1000, but the Mass on the meter is imported at 1250.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02145">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2145 FPC - Low indicated volume</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02145">

This exception is generated when the Indicated Volume (IV) value falls below the minimum limit set up in the Meter Editor for a liquid meter. For example, the minimum IV is set to 450, but the IV on the meter is imported at 425.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02146">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02146">

This exception is generated when the Indicated Volume (IV) value falls below the minimum limit set up in the Meter Editor for a liquid meter. For example, the maximum IV is set to 500, but the IV on the meter is imported at 575.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02147">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2147 FPC - Low net standard volume</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02147">

This exception is generated when the Net Standard Volume (NSV) value falls below the minimum limit set up in the Meter Editor for a liquid meter. For example, the minimum NSV is set to 400, but the NSV on the meter is calculated at 390.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02148">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02148">

This exception is generated when the Net Standard Volume (NSV) value falls below the minimum limit set up in the Meter Editor for a liquid meter. For example, the maximum NSV is set to 450, but the NSV on the meter is calculated at 490.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02151">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2151 FPC - Volume calculated from extension too low</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02151">

This exception is generated when a record’s Extension Ratio exceeds the user defined limit for minimum extension ratio. For example, the minimum extension ratio is set to 0.650, but the meter’s extension ratio is calculated at 0.550.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02152">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02152">

This exception is generated when a record’s Extension Ratio exceeds the user defined limit for maximum extension ratio. For example, the maximum extension ratio is set to 2.500, but the meter’s extension ratio is calculated at 2.750.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02153">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02153">

This exception is generated when a record’s Average Extension exceeds the user defined limit for minimum extension. For example, the minimum extension is set to 85.000, but the meter’s average extension is calculated at 75.000.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02154">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2154 FPC - Extension correlation too high</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02154">

This exception is generated when a record’s Average Extension exceeds the user defined limit for maximum extension. For example, the maximum extension is set to 185.000, but the meter’s average extension is calculated at 191.000.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02155">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02155">

This exception is generated when the Observed Density value falls below the minimum limit set up in the Meter Editor for a liquid meter. For example, the minimum Observed Density is set to 0.6, but the Observed Density on the meter is imported at 0.57.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02156">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2156 FPC - High observed density</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02156">

This exception is generated when the Observed Density value falls beyond the maximum limit set up in the Meter Editor for a liquid meter. For example, the maximum Observed Density is set to 0.65, but the Observed Density on the meter is imported at 0.67.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02157">

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02160">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2160 Analysis validation</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02160">

Analysis validation (ANLC) exceptions are related to the limits defined in the Analysis sub-tab of the Meter Editor Validations tab. Exceptions 2160 through 2229 are for gas meters. Liquid meter analysis validation generates exceptions 2402 through 2413. Analysis validation is performed against meter analysis data.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02161">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2161 ANLC - Low measured GPM</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02161">

This exception is generated when the sum of GPM values of C2 and above of a meter analysis record for  a gas meter falls below the minimum value for the GPM Total set up in the Meter Editor. This exception is generated for the violating meter analysis record and will be displayed in the Volume Editor for all meter periodic records that are associated with the meter analysis record. For example, the minimum GPM Total is set to 1.500, but the cumulative GPM for C2+ is 1.4641.

</div>
